That completes edge exploration across every feature block. Here's the **full settled scope** for your first version — in plain terms, everything you've approved:

**Saving & entries**
1. **Quick save with a review step** — paste a link; its details fill in automatically; you get a brief chance to correct the title/description (and add a note) before it's added, or discard.
2. **Recognizable entries** — each shows title, a short description, the site, its icon, and when you saved it.
3. **No duplicates** — re-saving an address (ignoring `http/https`, `www.`, trailing slash) takes you to the existing entry instead of copying it.

**Reading & keeping**
4. **Reading vs. archiving are independent** — Unread/Read is separate from active/archived, across three views: **All / Unread / Archived**. Archiving *puts away* without deleting; restoring keeps the prior read state.

**Organizing & finding**
5. **Tags** on every entry — add/remove with suggestions; filter by one or several at once (match all), within the current view.
6. **Editing** — fix the title, description, or the **address itself** (with the same duplicate guard), and add a **formatted personal note** (headings, bold, lists, links) shown distinctly from the page's own description.
7. **Strong search** within the current view — all-words matching, `"exact phrases"`, `#tag`, `AND/OR/NOT`, parentheses, highlighted results, and a **Search tips** link.
8. **Sort** — newest added / oldest added / title.

**Holding up at scale & edges**
9. **Large library** — Load more in ~25 batches, while search, filters, and counts always cover everything.
10. **Long content** — two-line titles, clamped descriptions, and a note preview with *Show full note*.
11. **Times** — relative when recent, actual dates (with year when needed) after about a week.
12. **Empty states & save errors** — calm empty messages; a clear message for a bad address; an unreachable page still saveable with details you type in.

It's a **web app for your computer, comfortable on a phone** — for you alone.

**Recorded for later (not in this build):** preserving a local copy of each page's content; importing existing browser bookmarks; and an optional "fetch details from a new address" action when you change an address. Sharing stays out of scope.

---

That's **13 settled feature flows.** May I now start building this scope for real — the actual application, not the exploratory prototype?
